#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> str;
    
    std::regex pattern("(.)\\1*");
    auto words_begin = std::sregex_iterator(str.begin(), str.end(), pattern);
    auto words_end = std::sregex_iterator();
    
    int insert = 0;
    for (std::sregex_iterator i = words_begin; i != words_end; ++i) {
        std::smatch match = *i;
        if (match.str().length() % 2 == 0) {
            insert++;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << insert << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
